title: Olay Super Serum, 1.7 oz (Pack of 2)

comparisons.notes: Olay Super Serum Super Size 1.7 oz is $66.65 each and in stock on olay.com; two bottles = $133.30

writeup: Woot has two full 1.7 oz bottles of Olay Super Serum, the 5-in-1 face serum with niacinamide, vitamin C, collagen peptide, vitamin E and AHA, for $49.99 total. Olay's own site sells the 1.7 oz size at $66.65 each, and Walmart charges $29.94 for the smaller 1 oz bottle, so this works out to about $14.70 per ounce. Limit 3 per customer.
